Main way until CT 1970s (Wiki x2, Am Sci, Radiopaedia). Headache/nausea/vomiting (Am Sci, Wiki, Radiopaedia). Chair rotation/upside down (Wiki + Am Sci). why_this_one: Follow-up to Sunday's '1884, no scans': how surgeons first SAW the brain, 1918, with a strange true twist (air into the brain). Clear 3D zoom (ventricles turning dark).
hooks: 1918. To see a brain on an X-ray... one surgeon pumped AIR into it. (picked)
Before CT, this is how surgeons found brain tumours. And it hurt.
1918. One surgeon looked at a bubble of air... and invented brain imaging.
